invitation.title: For [Name]
invitation.message: Something has been wrapped and sealed for you. It opens on your day — not a moment sooner. Until then, this is all you get to see.

password.hint: Four digits. The year the world got lucky.

lines: Parcel for one very specific person…
Sign here. Or just breathe. That works too.
Handle with care. It's been a long journey.

celebration.title: Make a wish
tries: Almost! Give it one more breath…
So close — the candles are stubborn tonight.

applause.title: Mic drop
lines: That was, hands down, the best candle-blowing this venue has ever seen.
Standing ovation. Somewhere, a stranger is weeping with joy.

gifts.title: The Jar of Stars
gifts.blurb: Twenty folded stars. Every one hides something.

stars.text: You are, objectively, the best thing this family has ever produced. Sorry to everyone else.
May you always find money in old jacket pockets.
DARE: send me the last photo in your camera roll. No deleting first.
Remember the wedding? You danced like nobody was watching. Nobody was. It was glorious.
May your chai always be exactly the right temperature.

gifts.title: Official Certificate
gifts.body: This certifies that [Name] has officially survived another year, with honours.
gifts.awardedBy: The Department of Extremely Serious Matters

coupons.name: Labour Coupon
coupons.detail: One (1) chore of your choosing, no complaints.

coupons.name: Forgiveness Coupon
coupons.detail: One free pass. Use it wisely.

coupons.name: Fight Advantage Coupon
coupons.detail: You win the next argument. Automatically.

gifts.title: The Future Teller
options: You will receive a gift today.
A mild inconvenience will befall a small appliance.
Someone nearby is thinking of you (it's us).
You will misplace something, then find it.
A great snack is in your future.

puzzle.clue: You've been counting all night. What's 2 × 10?
puzzle.reveal: It's 20. It's you. The whole thing was counting down to your day.

notes.title: A few last things
notes.goodbye: Happy birthday, [Name]. Here's to the next twenty.

keepsakes.title: We forgot to pack these
keepsakes.message: Everything from tonight, in one place. Take whatever you want home with you.
